text:
Priya: Quick question for promo comp timeline — finalizing a few EMEA promotions and want to confirm cutoffs.
Aisha: Hey! For this cycle manager approvals must be in by 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC. Evidence upload window was 2026-03-15 through 2026-04-18.
Priya: Got it. Payroll effective date is 2026-05-01 then? How do late approvals get handled for pay and backpay?
Aisha: Yes, effective 2026-05-01. If approval happens after the payroll cutoff we process retro (backpay) to the 05-01 effective date and it typically shows up within 2 payroll cycles after approvals are entered.
Sam: For hires outside the US, do we need a local comp approval step? Who initiates that?
Aisha: Managers mark region on submission and People Ops routes to Local Comp automatically. Local comp will either approve or request an adjustment; we notify the manager with the comp-owner and reason.
Diego: If a manager misses the evidence window, is there a formal exception path?
Aisha: Yes — submit an exception request (Request Type = "Late Evidence") using the internal form. Exceptions need People Ops + Manager Exec signoff and 2 supporting artifacts.
Aisha: Exception form: https://redwood.company/internal/promo-exceptions
Priya: We need a manager-facing evidence template. A lot of back-and-forth happening due to sparse notes.
Aisha: Use this short template — paste into the submission or attach as doc:
```
Candidate: <Name> / Role
Current Level: <L3>
Proposed Level: <L4>
Quick summary (2 lines): scope + business impact
Concrete examples (3): bullet each, include metrics/links
Manager recommendation: salary band + justification
Attachments: 2 supporting docs (metrics, PRs, peer feedback)
Comp Queue ID: <auto-populated when submitted>
```
Sam: Thanks. Also: how is base vs equity prorated if promotion effective mid-pay-period?
Aisha: Base is prorated from effective date. Equity/grants follow our equity ops schedule — usually the next grant window; we note the grant timing in approval so Equity Ops can schedule.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for promo approvals is 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC. Late approvals will enter exception review. :bell:
Diego: For roles that are matrixed (e.g., eng + PM), does the system require two manager endorsements?
Aisha: One manager submission is fine but include a short corroboration from partnering manager (email snippet or note) to speed review.
Priya: Last edge case: if evidence is confidential (M&A or legal constraints), what should managers do?
Aisha: Mark submission as `Confidential`, DM People Ops and tag Legal. We'll move it to a redacted review queue and arrange exec-level signoff if necessary.
Priya: Great — I'll send this template to my managers. Thanks!
Sam: Will remind the team to attach two artifacts and confirm region. :thumbsup:
